## Research question

What question should this research answer?

## Relevance to IMXO

Explain why the result may affect IMXO requirements, design, compatibility, security, or conformance.

## Scope

List the standards, versions, alternatives, and exclusions to examine.

## Sources

Provide primary or authoritative sources with versions, dates, and exact sections where possible.

## Expected output

Describe the proposed research document or comparison and the open questions it should preserve.

## Checklist

- [ ] This proposal distinguishes verified facts from interpretation.
- [ ] It does not present an architectural hypothesis as an accepted decision.
- [ ] It does not publish a potentially sensitive unpatched vulnerability.
- [ ] Any later substantive decision will be recorded separately in an ADR.
